The purpose of this document is to give an understanding over the data that is to be provided to Eudamed and that can be communicated through Data Exchange process for the Notified Bodies and Certificates module. 

The document presents the different attributes related to Notified Bodies and Certificates that may be communicated through XML, their correspondence to the fields from EUDAMED User Interface, the description of each field apart and the Rules applying at the level of the Entity of for each specific field apart.

Each attribute is defined by the Entity were it resides and the attribute name.
